The '''International Slide Rule Museum''' ('''ISRM''') is an American museum dedicated to the preservation and display of [[slide rule]]s and other mathematical artefacts. Established in 2003 by Michael Konshak, who serves as its [[curator]],<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=ISRM Board of Directors |url=https://www.sliderulemuseum.com/ISRM_BoardOfDirectors.shtml |access-date=2024-04-17 |website=www.sliderulemuseum.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last=Anderson |first=David V. |title=Sick Schools: Diagnosis, Cure, and Prevention of School Maladies |publisher=Resource Publications |year=2020 |isbn=978-1532696862}}</ref> the museum houses a collection of slide rules from diverse manufacturers and time periods, showcasing the evolution and importance of these instruments in the history of mathematics and engineering.

It is often identified to be one of the largest repositories of slide rules and logarithmic calculators.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Kimberli |first=Turner |date=2009-10-07 |title=Slide Rule: 101 |work=Colorado Hometown Newspapers}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Keane |first=Maribeth |title=Calculating the Quality of Vintage Slide Rules |url=https://www.collectorsweekly.com/articles/an-interview-with-vintage-slide-rule-collector-mike-konshak/ |access-date=2023-11-25 |website=Collectors Weekly |language=en}}</ref>

==Key people==
===Board of Directors===
The museum's operations are overseen by its governing body, the Board of Directors, presently composed of nine members. Each member of the Board fulfills a role in the stewardship and guidance of the institution.<ref name=":2" />

'''Leadership Positions:''' 
* Director and Curator – Michael V. Konshak<ref name=":2" /><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Introduction to ISRM and Slide Rules |url=https://www.sliderulemuseum.com/SRM_Intro.shtml |access-date=2024-09-25 |website=www.sliderulemuseum.com}}</ref>
* Trustee and Treasurer – Rebecca A. Konshak<ref name=":2" />
* Head of Public Communications, Education, etc. – ''{{ill|Marvin Clarence|id}}''<ref name=":2" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=ISRM Slide Rule Who's Who Past and Present |url=https://www.sliderulemuseum.com/SR_WhosWho.shtml |access-date=2024-09-25 |website=www.sliderulemuseum.com}}</ref>
